item.name: Potable_Water_Hose
item.description: Camco TastePURE 25 ft drinking-water hose, 5/8 in inner diameter, lead- and BPA-free (22783).
item.readyBeforeUse: The hose is used only for potable water and has no visible damage or dirt inside its fittings.
item.readyForNextPerson: The hose is drained, coiled, and stored with both ends off the playa.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use a garden or gray-water hose. Tell the Dominatrix.
